context.en: Here: Korean shares held by foreigners count as a liability at market value, so rising share prices lower the position without new borrowing.

context.en: Here: mostly what Korean companies pay over the Korean government on bonds of the same maturity.

context.en: Here: extra cash owed on currency hedges, such as forwards and swaps, that lose value when the won falls, as for Korean banks in 2022.
context.ko: 이 글에서는 원화가 떨어질 때 손실이 나는 선물환·스와프 같은 환헤지 계약에 대해 추가로 내야 하는 현금을 말하며, 2022년 한국 은행들이 이를 겪었다.

title.en: Korea's economy grew more slowly, not faster, when the won weakened against the dollar
